baselineComparison.method: Annual prior mosaic captured before the review. Tinos inherits only its former parent Mykonos for the geometric comparison; this does not validate that prior attribution.

geometryVerification.tinosSubdivision: Original Mykonos compound path archived with SHA256; Tinos split from its disconnected loop. Exterior area preserved, no overlapping area, all accepted geometry reproduced by the locked Python environment.
